title: Mixed Event — Doll Festival at the Tenma's — Episode5 A Dejected Duo

meta.Event Outline: It's the first Doll Festival since Saki returned to school! In the midst of his enthusiastic preparations, Tsukasa looks back on a bitter childhood memory. He then executes his plan to do something special for Saki, but will it go as he hopes...?!

rows.Line: Lunch Break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Corridor

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*...
What should I do...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Ichi's busy with class representative stuff today, so I'm safe for now... But if she sees me like this...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, Saki. I was thinking about baking an apple... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hm? H-Hona...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Saki, what's wrong...?
Your eyes are all red too...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? N-No, I'm fine!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We're having our special party today, so I'm super excited...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So excited...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Waahhh! Honaaa!!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: S-Saki?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa... He...!!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I see... And you two ended up fighting over that...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: *Sob*... Yeah... He completely forgot about how much those dolls mean to me and...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I know, they mean everything to you...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Did he really forget about that?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I can't say that I know Tsukasa all that well but...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I just don't think he'd forget about something like that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I mean, you mean everything to him, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Waaahhhhh!
What do I do, Hona?!
I was so mean to him and...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wha...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: He always works so hard to cheer me up...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Even when I was in the hospital, I was able to get through it because of him...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: He went out of his way to buy me some new dolls and I just ended up saying some terrible things to him...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: *Sob*... Do you think he'll come home today...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I want to make up and celebrate with him...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm finally healthy and can celebrate at home like this... But at this rate, it'll end up being worse than when I was still sick...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
It'll be okay.
I'm sure he'll be there.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, how about you send him a text? It might be easier to tell him how you really feel than telling him in person.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I already sent him a message about him forgetting his lunch, but it says he hasn't even read it...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: He's so mad that he won't even look at what I'm sending him...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Even if I do apologize to him, he won't see it...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (What should we do...? I can't imagine Tsukasa not being there for her but...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (If he does end up missing the party, Saki won't actually be able to enjoy it...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Is there anything that I can do...?
Lunch Break
Kamiyama High School - Corridor

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (This is a rare sight...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (It says Tsukasa hasn't even read the message I sent him.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I was hoping to hear if the new dolls he bought were okay but...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I suppose that can wait. It is Tsukasa after all. I'm sure he's busy thinking about how to make that party as fun as possible...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
*Sigh*...
How did this happen...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Tsukasa...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh? O-Oh, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hello! Thank you again for yesterday!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Um, I'm glad I was able to help.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I sent you a message earlier, and it looks like you haven't even seen it yet...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Huh? A message?
All morning, my phone hasn't...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! How the?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No! I left it at home...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see, that explains everything.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm sorry for not getting back to you... Is there something you'd like to talk about?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, no. It's not urgent or anything...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I was just wondering if Saki liked the dolls you bought for her is all...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, did something happen...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, she and I got into a fight...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
With Saki?
How?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This morning, I tried to swap out the old dolls with the new ones, but she said the old ones were better...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It escalated into a big fight and I rushed off to school after that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No, don't feel bad!
None of this is your fault!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I really do appreciate your help, and I'll make sure to return the favor later!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But it's time for lunch and I require some brain food! You should do the same, Toya, in preparation for the afternoon!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Tsukasa... He's been working so hard to make sure Saki fully enjoys the Doll Festival...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Is there anything that I can do...?
